purpose: Teach: 快速/鶴岡/マシーン/ドミノ/フロンティア/アジアン/ロッキー/マーラー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが快速電車に乗せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he'll take you on the express train.
lines.style: Warm, almost wistful. Speaking as if sharing something precious. Soft, deliberate pacing. A slight smile beneath the words—pleased to carry this news to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと鶴岡八幡宮行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to Tsurugaoka Hachimangu with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager bounce on the opening. Quick, animated delivery. Eyes bright with the memory. Speaking as if she'll understand exactly why this matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがコーヒーマシーンを新しく買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought a new coffee machine.
lines.style: Gentle, almost musing. Speaking as if these small details are worth noticing. Warm underneath—the kind of observation that shows she's been paying attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとドミノ倒し遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I played domino toppling with Dad!
lines.style: Quick, vivid energy. Like the memory is still spinning in his head. Small laugh underneath. Genuinely delighted to report it, as if she was there watching.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフロンティア精神について教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught me about the frontier spirit.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Pause before 'frontier spirit'—the weight of something learned. Not explaining, but sharing something she's turning over in her mind. Quiet reverence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとアジアン料理屋さん行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went to an Asian restaurant!
lines.style: Unguarded excitement. Clear, direct. The satisfaction of having done something good and wanting to tell her immediately. Small-boy certainty that she'll be happy to hear it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがロッキー山脈の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad will read you a picture book about the Rocky Mountains.
lines.style: Soft, anticipatory. Speaking of something that hasn't happened yet, but will. Slight lean forward—conspiritorial warmth. As if she's offering him something to look forward to.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとマーラーの曲聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I listened to Mahler with Dad!
lines.style: Immediate, unfiltered happiness. Slightly breathless—like he's been holding this in and now it's spilling out. Pure delight at having shared something grown-up with his father.
